description.narrative:
The ILO has provided continued technical support to Malaysia to improve the situation of forced and child labour with the aim to strengthen capacity of the Government of Malaysia and other relevant stakeholders to address forced labour, child labour and human trafficking; to reduce vulnerability to child labour and forced labour in the Electronics and Electrical sectors through strengthening of legal framework, freedom of association and the right to collective bargaining. In the nutshell, technical support provision is in 3 folds: 1. Policy development; 2. Workers' capacity development; and 3. Awareness of child labour.
At policy level, the ILO is the key technical partner engaging in the process of formulating a Roapmap for National Action Plan on Forced Labour (NAP-FL) as well as the endorsement of the National Action Plan on Business and Human Rights (NAP-BHR) in 2024-25.
